name: minewright
description: Evergreen skills for building Minecraft Bedrock add-ons with AI coding agents: design rules and Script API patterns that hold up, project layout and packaging with current module versions, one-command static checks, live self-tests on Bedrock Dedicated Server, and HUD work with a vanilla fallback. Each skill re-researches its subject on a schedule and carries the evals that prove it triggers and acts.
